_source: Task 0 probe (#6), Claude Code 2.1.277, 2026-09-28. One SessionStart payload per observed 'source' value, from a fresh run, then '-c'/--continue, then a '/clear' prompt issued under -c. session_id is stable across startup and resume, but /clear issues a fresh one (a 'resume' SessionStart fires first, to process the /clear message in the old session, then a 'clear' SessionStart fires with the new id).
